deficits.evidence: No purpose-built sidewalk is present; the area is occupied by building fronts and parked vehicles.
deficits.suggestion: Construct a continuous, purpose-built sidewalk on the left side to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

deficits.evidence: The pedestrian area is an unpaved, informal path.
deficits.suggestion: Upgrade the informal path on the right side to a paved, purpose-built sidewalk.

deficits.evidence: High commercial activity on the left and residential/green areas on the right create crossing demand, but no formal crossing exists.
deficits.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing to provide a safe point for people to cross this multi-lane road.

ratings.reason: The left side lacks a formal sidewalk, but the suggestion is a generic measure and the available space for construction is unclear.
The right side has an unpaved verge rather than a proper footway, but the suggestion is generic and feasibility is unclear.
No marked crossing is visible, but the suggestion is generic and it is unclear if the road width allows for a safe crossing.
